g.text: ChronoPack prioritizes dynamically timed ligand-receptor signals before K562 NF-kB activation

ChronoPack r9 data. NicheNet uses THP1 ligand detection over 0-75 min and K562b peak-response targets (peak log2FC > 0.5, p < 0.05) ranked by corrected AUPR; TraSig uses 10,000 permutations. Part B shows top-10 ligand log2FC distributions from 0 to 45 min with pseudocount 0.01.

Trajectories show ChronoPack NB-GAM fits (8 knots; log1p fitted mean count at the reference library size, THP1 2,528 / K562 3,306 UMIs) for the top 10 ligands (THP1) and K562 NFKBIA, excluding CellChat. † not in the r9 THP1 tradeSeq inputs (low-count or technical filter); fitted from unfiltered counts.
